main.en: Taking refuge in Amitabha, the Buddha of Limitless Light.

main.zh: 敬禮如來，並說咒語如下：
main.en: Homage to the Tathagata; and the mantra is spoken thus:
main.simp: 敬礼如来，并说咒语如下：

main.en: He who is born of the nectar of immortality.
Nectar; he who arises from accomplishment.
Nectar; the one of vast power.
Going forward unhindered, wide as space.

main.zh: 廣作功德名聲，願圓滿成就。
main.en: Spreading far the renown of merit; may all be fulfilled. Svaha.
main.simp: 广作功德名声，愿圆满成就。
